desc: Start loadout + buy wheel (D6: rows with buy_wheel_index >= 0, max 12). Bound cells: {"cs2": "*"} = the column bind template expanded with this row (generator), or an explicit {"cs2": "<alias>:<key path>"}; aliases in hooks.json (vdata = scripts/weapons.vdata_c, items = scripts/items/items_game.txt); Pair columns are CS2 [mode0, mode1] (mode1 = silencer on / scoped / burst); scalars normalize to [v, v]; a constant number in a bound column = n/a. Column default = value the game uses when the key is absent in CS2 data. Units: CS units (u), 1 u = 0.0254 m. Evidence: CS2 build 25815307, VRF CLI 20.0 decompile; display_name, buy_wheel_index, suspicion_radius_m are design (D5/D6/D9).

cs2_item.desc: CS2 classname = block in weapons.vdata_c / item name in items_game

start_loadout.desc: given at start and after every death (BRIEF)

suppressed.desc: D5; M4A1-S silencer is always on in v1

default_mode.desc: index into pair columns used by default

kill_award.desc: USD; D3 reward = kill_award x economy.kill_award_factor x machine.kill_reward_mult

armor_ratio.desc: CS armor rule, see systems combat.armor_*

penetration.desc: read, unused in v1 (no wall penetration)

reload_time.desc: s (matches known CS reload times; per shell if reload_single_shells); cs2 cross-checks vs the reload clip length

max_speed.desc: u/s; player run speed with this item active

armor_points.desc: kevlar only; CS2 code constant, not in data

world_model.desc: vmdl; also the weapon mesh of view.glb

view_anim_graph.desc: AnimGraph2 graph in pak01 (clip list source); none = no viewmodel

content_model.desc: cache-relative model files: view = first-person arms + weapon (origin = eye, -Z forward, bones and points below refer to it), world = static world model; {} parts absent = not applicable

bone_roles.desc: role -> bone name in view.glb: camera/root (view origin = eye), attach (arms bone the weapon hangs on), hand_r, hand_l, weapon (weapon root), mag, bolt, trigger, pin; roles a weapon lacks are omitted; {} = no viewmodel

points.desc: name -> {bone, offset [x,y,z] m in the bone's local frame, rotation [x,y,z,w], forward [x,y,z] bone-local, kind}; muzzle, eject, mag_drop, flame; from the weapon model's attachments (inches x 0.0254)

snd_shoot.desc: = vdata m_aShootSounds.WEAPON_SOUND_SINGLE (SPECIAL1 for the silenced M4A1-S); none for knife/grenades/armor

snd_events.desc: other soundevents (game_sounds_weapons.vsndevts_c); timing comes from vnmclip sound events
